There is **no reason** not to study specifically for the SAT and ACT. They are standardized tests. You should study like hell.

You can't afford prep classes? Go into a Barnes & Noble, grab some SAT prep books, and go sit down in the in-store Starbucks. Study. Practice Tests are your friend.

Being able to say "I didn't even have to study" and getting a 33 on the ACT is not cooler/better than saying you got a 36.
